env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd g
cp ../clean.src p.go
logos build .
! stderr .
logos lint .
! stderr .
cp ../bad.src p.go
logos build .
! stderr .
! logos lint --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=2 '"rule_id":"correctness::arena_pointer_escape"'
stderr -count=2 '"severity":"deny"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
! logos lint .
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::arena_pointer_escape\]'
cp ../suppressed.src p.go
logos lint .
! stderr .
cp ../forbid.toml logos.toml
logos build .
! stderr .
logos lint .
! stderr .
cd ..

cd l
cp ../clean.src p.lgo
logos build .
! stderr .
logos lint .
! stderr .
cp ../bad.src p.lgo
logos build .
! stderr .
! logos lint --json-diagnostics .
stderr -count=2 '"rule_id":"correctness::arena_pointer_escape"'
stderr -count=2 '"severity":"deny"'
! stderr '(?m)^[^{\r\n]'
! logos lint .
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::arena_pointer_escape\]'
cp ../suppressed.src p.lgo
logos lint .
! stderr .
cp ../forbid.toml logos.toml
logos build .
! stderr .
! logos lint .
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::arena_pointer_escape\]'
stderr -count=2 '\[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27
-- l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27
-- forbid.toml --
[lints]
correctness = "forbid"
-- clean.src --
package p

import "unsafe"

func Allocated() unsafe.Pointer { return unsafe.Pointer(new(int)) }

func Local() unsafe.Pointer {
	var value int
	return unsafe.Pointer(&value)
}

func Address() uintptr {
	var value int
	address := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&value))
	return address
}

func Offset(p unsafe.Pointer, offset uintptr) unsafe.Pointer {
	return unsafe.Pointer(offset + uintptr(p))
}

func SliceView(b []byte) []byte {
	return unsafe.Slice(unsafe.SliceData(b), len(b))
}

func StringView(s string) string {
	return unsafe.String(unsafe.StringData(s), len(s))
}
-- bad.src --
package p

import (
	"reflect"
	"unsafe"
)

func Restored(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer {
	address := uintptr(p)
	return unsafe.Pointer(address)
}

func Header() *reflect.SliceHeader {
	return &reflect.SliceHeader{}
}
-- suppressed.src --
package p

import (
	"reflect"
	"unsafe"
)

//logos:allow(correctness::arena_pointer_escape)
func Restored(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer {
	address := uintptr(p)
	return unsafe.Pointer(address)
}

//logos:allow(correctness::arena_pointer_escape)
func Header() *reflect.SliceHeader {
	return &reflect.SliceHeader{}
}
